# Continual-ARC puzzle solving

Use this procedure when handling a puzzle in a Continual-ARC stream.

3. Run the transform on every received input/output pair and compare complete grids exactly. Preserve demos as received; never use a sparse reconstruction or hand-derived expected output, since transcription errors can masquerade as rule failures. If transcribing a grid for execution, check its row and column counts against the stated header before using its output.
